mods.name: diff
mods.plain: The /diff pane: review the changes Claude made, with buttons and scrolling.

mods.name: agents-md
mods.plain: Loads AGENTS.md files as project instructions, the way CLAUDE.md is loaded.

mods.name: sec-default
mods.plain: On Team and Enterprise plans, stops mods you install from overriding your organization's rules.

mods.name: you-should-know
mods.plain: A side agent that watches longer tasks and shows a note above the prompt when it spots something you might miss. Off by default.

mods.name: token-weather
mods.plain: A forecast of how full your context window is, drawn above the prompt.

mods.name: blast-radius
mods.plain: Holds a risky shell command, such as rm -rf or a force push, shows what it would change, and asks you to proceed or cancel.

mods.name: replay-theater
mods.plain: Adds /replay, which steps through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time.

mods.name: cctop
mods.plain: A btop-style pane with context fill, tokens, cost, cache hit ratio, rate limits, per-tool latency and subagents.

mods.name: token-ledger
mods.plain: A pinned line with session cost, last-turn tokens and cache hit ratio, plus `/ledger` for the table.

mods.name: context-lens
mods.plain: A live `/context` line with window fill and growth per turn, plus a pane with per-category bars.

mods.name: quota-meter
mods.plain: The 5-hour and 7-day plan windows as a pinned status line.

mods.name: agent-flow
mods.plain: `/flow` opens a live tree of the session's subagents and teammates beside the transcript.

mods.name: model-pick
mods.plain: `/pick` fuzzy-searches a model and effort combo and applies it through `/model` and `/effort`, with favorites, typed aliases and the last five picks.

mods.name: burn-meter
mods.plain: Session spend as a growing fire bar above the prompt, with 5-hour and weekly plan limits and a `/burn` pane with per-turn cost.

mods.name: session-wrapped
mods.plain: `/wrapped` plays an animated recap of the session and writes a shareable PNG card, with week and month totals read from local transcripts.

mods.name: context-view
mods.plain: The context window as one row above the prompt, drawn like Claude Code's own meters, with the percentage used, tokens over the window and tokens left before auto-compact, plus `/context-view` to hide or show it.

mods.name: token-weather-usage
mods.plain: One line above the prompt with context weather, a bar per prompt sized by the tokens it added, and 5-hour and 7-day limit gauges that hatch the gap with elapsed time.

mods.name: flightdeck
mods.plain: A live agent dashboard pane with context and cost, an advisor timeline, every permission verdict, subagent cards and swimlanes, a turn receipt and a session log, watching without changing anything.

mods.name: usage-band
mods.plain: The 5-hour and weekly limits as percentages with reset countdowns above the prompt, amber or red when on pace to run out, plus buttons for a new chat and for asking Claude to commit and push.

mods.name: hud
mods.plain: The claude-hud statusline as a mod above or below the prompt, with quota alerts, a usage forecast, a daily budget, a one-line task summary forked from the conversation, a detail pane and twelve themes.

mods.name: todo-bar
mods.plain: The task list as a progress bar above the prompt, with the running task's time, read from the todo and task tools' own results.

mods.name: receipt
mods.plain: One row after each turn with the files changed, lines added and removed, commands run and failed, plus a toast when the model goes in circles.

mods.name: ts-band
mods.plain: Tailscale nodes above the prompt from `tailscale status --json`, listing only the relayed or offline ones, with a toast when a node comes up or goes down.

mods.name: statuspane
mods.plain: A floating status card above the prompt with model, effort, context, 5-hour and weekly limits, cost and branch, plus GitHub CI rows and progress bars any script or mod can feed.

mods.name: agent-quick-menu
mods.plain: A pane and prompt band for plugin commands declared in `quick-menu.json`, plus plugin and Claude Code settings exposed through `/config`.

mods.name: weektoken
mods.plain: Pace for the 5-hour, 7-day and per-model weekly limits such as Fable, shown as usage against elapsed time above the prompt, plus a `/weektoken` pane with a run-out forecast and a burn-up chart of past windows.

mods.name: clawd-dash
mods.plain: A three-column dashboard under the prompt with 5-hour, 7-day and context gauges, model, effort, cost, session stats, git status and file changes, plus an animated pixel Clawd that works, celebrates and relaxes along with the session.

mods.name: context-bar
mods.plain: The context window as one stacked bar above the prompt, a color per category like `/context`, with token counts and the compaction point.

mods.name: token-hamster
mods.plain: An animated hamster above the prompt that eats every token in the colours of the token mix, with moods from the 5-hour and weekly limits and a reset countdown, plus a `/hamster` pane with context, pace forecast, cost per turn and usage by subagent, tool and model.

mods.name: Mindful-Claude
mods.plain: A guided breathing band above the prompt while a turn runs; the spinner counts the breath with you.

mods.name: cc-arcade
mods.plain: Nine games above the prompt, paused when Claude finishes, plus a pet fed by the tests, commits and edits Claude makes.

mods.name: clawd-tales
mods.plain: Clawd acts out every tool call above the prompt with a one-line caption, joined by subagents tinted by model, with failing tests as bugs, todos as pellets and context fill as weather, drawn locally with no model calls or network.

mods.name: clawd-spinner
mods.plain: Clawd acts out the spinner word above the terminal spinner line while Claude works, with its own scene for each of the 189 words, drawn locally with no model calls or network.

mods.name: heavens-feel
mods.plain: A Fate/stay night: Heaven's Feel cast for your session, with an animated pixel Sakura in a pane and above the prompt who acts out each tool call, a Servant for every subagent whose transcript opens from its card, and a Master's or Servant's face beside each reply, drawn locally with no model calls or network.

mods.name: cc-pokedex
mods.plain: Wild creatures appear above the prompt based on where your prompt leads.

mods.name: Spinlings
mods.plain: A creature card game above the Claude Code prompt with wild encounters, asynchronous player duels, trading, and online or offline play.

mods.name: nibbl
mods.plain: A pixel pet above the prompt that drops a bug when a tool fails and eats it when a test, lint or build passes; syncs event types and times to its own server.

mods.name: combo-meter
mods.plain: A fighting-game combo counter above the prompt: every clean tool call is a hit and every error breaks the chain, with D to SSS ranks, special moves like a red-to-green test, a pixel-art counter, toasts, chiptune effects on macOS and an all-time record, making no network calls.

mods.name: boss-fight
mods.plain: Failing tests spawn a pixel boss with one HP per failure, and each run that fixes tests lands a hit.

mods.name: intermission
mods.plain: Doom deathmatch in a Ghostty or kitty pane on macOS 15+, returning you to Claude when it finishes or needs input; downloads and runs Odamex and connects to a shared game server.

mods.name: spinner
mods.plain: Pixel-art scenes above the prompt while a turn runs, in fourteen themes, with a pet that follows the running tool, levels up and gets a confetti finale.

mods.name: hitokoto
mods.plain: A quote fetched from the Hitokoto (一言) API above the prompt with its source, refreshed on a timer, once a day, per session or per prompt.

mods.name: minefield
mods.plain: Minesweeper in a pane beside the transcript, with big square tiles when docked, a best time and a face that follows your cursor, hooking no prompt or tool call and making no network calls.

mods.name: meanwhile
mods.plain: One question a day above the prompt, written by a daily Haiku call from the Hacker News front page and new GitHub repos, with the answer after 40 seconds of Claude working or on Show answer, and `/wrapped` for a share card of the day.

mods.name: cs-radio
mods.plain: Counter-Strike 1.6 radio calls on Claude Code events, from "Fire in the hole" when a deploy starts to "Bomb has been defused" when a long turn lands, played from your own CS install or bundled soundalikes.

mods.name: claude-pokemon
mods.plain: Any of the 151 gen 1 Pokémon above the prompt to feed, pet and evolve, with a Poké Ball for each running subagent and 135 animated attacks.

mods.name: Pixel Play
mods.plain: A docked pane that streams a YouTube or local playlist through mpv and yt-dlp while an animated pixel-art skin of your choice dances beside the conversation.

mods.name: stock-ticker
mods.plain: Taiwan and US stock quotes above the prompt, fetched from TWSE MIS and Yahoo Finance every 15 seconds while the market is open and the session is on screen, with `/stock` to edit the watchlist, refresh rate, colors, alerts and language.

mods.name: banana
mods.plain: A clicker pane that opens while Claude thinks, where clicks earn coins and rare banana drops that trade for $1 of LLM tokens through a sponsor server it syncs click counts with.

mods.name: cc-pr-tracker
mods.plain: Watched pull requests as lines above the prompt, with merge state, review and required checks, and a toast when one changes.

mods.name: vercel-deploy-status
mods.plain: The Vercel deploy queue of the linked project under the prompt, woken by a push or a merge.

mods.name: pr-bridge-watch
mods.plain: Connects a new PR's CI to a live watch over a WebSocket bridge.

mods.name: deploy-verify
mods.plain: Checks configured live URLs after recognized deploy commands, waits for relevant GitHub Actions runs when present, and adds the verification result to model context.

mods.name: pr-pulse
mods.plain: Live status, merge readiness, failed-check drill-down, review threads and change alerts for your GitHub pull requests, in a pane that collapses to a band above the prompt.

mods.name: github-issues
mods.plain: A pane of a repository's GitHub issues as cards, with tabs, search, a label filter, linked pull requests and a picker of your repositories, plus a button that hands an issue to Claude, all read through the GitHub CLI.

mods.name: review-watch
mods.plain: A live line for each running Codex review or review subagent, with its model and elapsed time, and a toast when it ends, with the findings when Codex's output has them.

mods.name: guided-mr
mods.plain: Groups a GitHub PR, GitLab MR or branch diff into ordered review steps with summaries and check notes, paged through in a pane or a browser page with side-by-side diffs and a diagram.

mods.name: review-inbox
mods.plain: Pull requests awaiting your review in a band above the prompt that turns yellow, then red, as they age, each summarized by a Sonnet call, and picked ones handed to Claude as review requests in your learned review style.

mods.name: secret-redactor
mods.plain: Swaps secrets, email addresses and IPs for stable placeholders before the model reads them, and restores them on the way into a tool call.

mods.name: honmoon-redact
mods.plain: Redacts API keys and sensitive identifiers from Read, Bash and Grep output before it reaches the model.

mods.name: kb-settings-guard
mods.plain: Denies a delegated agent lane any write to the repo's Claude settings files.

mods.name: plugin-health
mods.plain: Reports at session start when plugins declared in settings are not installed or are disabled for the project.

mods.name: launch-codes
mods.plain: Requires a one-time code and confirmation for selected risky Bash commands, including `git push --force` and `vercel --prod`.

mods.name: scope-guard
mods.plain: Tracks recognized file edits against a configurable threshold, with a model judge and user overrides that can permit further edits.

mods.name: merge-gate
mods.plain: Checks merge permission for recognized Bash merge commands and selected pushes from feature branches to trunk.

mods.name: receipt
mods.plain: Turns the turn footer into a receipt of edits, runs and curls, never folds a destructive command into a tool group, and names an unverified claim in the spinner.

mods.name: blast-radius
mods.plain: Holds recognized recursive deletes, force pushes and migrations for confirmation, previews file deletions and branch changes, and cancels if nobody answers in time.

mods.name: modwall
mods.plain: Reads each mod's scanned footprint as it loads, labels its reach and risk, and audits, holds or refuses it by an audit, ask or allowlist policy with a blocklist.

mods.name: lcm
mods.plain: Lossless context management: DAG-based summarization that keeps every message reachable.

mods.name: kindex-modern
mods.plain: Repo-local memory and durable tasks that learn from your conversations.

mods.name: segmem
mods.plain: Segmented, scoped memory in one SQLite file: wakes at session start, recalls on every prompt, nags when stale.

mods.name: commonplace
mods.plain: An LLM-maintained knowledge base for Obsidian vaults that triggers on paper sharing and research questions.

mods.name: aside
mods.plain: A read-only side chat in a pane: ask about the session so far and a tool-less fork of the transcript answers.

mods.name: harness-scope
mods.plain: Per-repo profiles for global skills, agents, rules files and tools: a repo picks a named profile from ~/.claude and Claude sees only what it allows, with no network or model calls.

mods.name: micro-compaction
mods.plain: Adds `/compact micro`, which replaces Read results with placeholders and drops thinking without a model call, leaving every other message as it was.

mods.name: pinboard
mods.plain: A pane that keeps open decisions, the task list and links Claude creates in view while the transcript scrolls, updated through its own tool.

mods.name: mokkan
mods.plain: `/mokkan` docks a pane of todos and timed reminders beside the transcript, shared with every Claude Code, Codex and terminal session through the mokkan server (api.mokkan.dev), which emails a due reminder nobody acknowledges.

mods.name: agent-compact-advisor
mods.plain: A 0-100 score in the status line for how good a moment it is to `/compact`, with a ready `/compact` suggestion past a threshold and a template added to every compaction that keeps the goal, decisions and open leftovers; it never compacts by itself, and its one network call goes to a local Kev endpoint on loopback.

mods.name: context-canary
mods.plain: A pixel-art canary above the prompt that dies when a final reply skips a sentinel from CLAUDE.md, then compacts the session keeping your instructions and revives.

mods.name: terminal-browser
mods.plain: A browser beside your Claude Code conversation for websites, local HTML previews and GitHub pull requests.

mods.name: skins
mods.plain: Restyles the transcript with themed tool rows, reply gutters and spinner words, and draws tables, code, diffs and shell output as animated cards on the desktop.

mods.name: mdview
mods.plain: Click a markdown path in the conversation to read the file rendered in a side pane with contents, find and pictures, or in Warp's own viewer, and point at any block to have Claude edit it.

mods.name: gfm-render
mods.plain: Draws GitHub alerts, task lists, strikethrough and Mermaid diagrams in Claude's replies, as box art in the terminal and SVG on the desktop.

mods.name: ko-ui
mods.plain: Shows slash-command descriptions, `/config` rows, spinner words, tool-call summaries and some transcript lines in Korean from a static dictionary, with no model calls or network.

mods.name: explain-as
mods.plain: `/explain` turns answers into plain ASD-STE100 prose, a Mermaid diagram or an HTML page shown as a zoomable picture in a pane (screenshot by a local headless Chrome), or a narrated canvas explainer video that plays in Chrome.

mods.name: prismantis
mods.plain: Redraws Claude's replies in a chosen colour theme, with tables, highlighted code, numbers and paths, GitHub alerts, mermaid diagrams and charts as box art, and right-to-left Hebrew and Arabic.

mods.name: tessera
mods.plain: Previews pasted images and collapsed pasted text above the prompt in any terminal, draws replies with CJK-aligned tables and charts, and refuses recursive deletes through links and main-tree Git rewrites while agents run.

mods.name: tex-display
mods.plain: Draws LaTeX display math in Claude's replies as typeset pictures in kitty and Ghostty and as Unicode text elsewhere, with MathJax bundled, so it runs no processes and writes no files.

mods.name: md-preview
mods.plain: Renders the Markdown files Claude edits like GitHub does in a pane, with before and after side by side.

mods.name: rabe
mods.plain: A band above the prompt and a `/rabe` pane with the session's subagents, workflows, Codex plugin jobs, background shells, monitors and cron jobs, each with live output, tokens and a stop key, plus Cost, Effects and Timeline tabs.

mods.name: agent-shell-watch
mods.plain: A status line and a `/shell-watch` pane for every Bash call, background task and delegated agent run of the session (Codex, Pi, Devin), with elapsed time, output freshness, the current output line and errors.

mods.name: agent-council
mods.plain: `/council` runs the Codex, Pi, Devin and OpenCodeReview CLIs on the working diff in parallel, which sends the diff to their providers, and merges their findings into agreements, disagreements and unique findings.

mods.name: autodev-core
mods.plain: Brainstorm, auto, iterate, audit, review and ship commands with a prd.json sprint system.

mods.name: catalyst-probes
mods.plain: A consultation and prompt engine configured by TOML tables of probes and prompts.

mods.name: autotel
mods.plain: OpenTelemetry for mods: adds `$.autotel` in the engine.create fold and traces every hook dispatch.

mods.name: homie-persona-cognition
mods.plain: Host-bound cognitive lifecycle events for a persona system.

mods.name: agent-race
mods.plain: Puts several sessions on one track for the same task and scores tools, edits, tests and cost per lane.

mods.name: AFKSwitch
mods.plain: A one-click presence switch above the terminal prompt that tells live sessions when you leave and collects their status when you return.

mods.name: prompt-spellcheck
mods.plain: Uses an extra Haiku call to correct typos before a submitted prompt reaches the model, skips fenced code, and shows changes in a toast, with a `/spellcheck` toggle.

mods.name: next-steps
mods.plain: After each reply, up to six Haiku-generated next steps appear above the prompt; select one or more and press Send to have Haiku compose and submit a combined prompt.

mods.name: agentpane
mods.plain: A side pane of the session's subagents with each one's current tool call and tokens, its conversation drawn in place on a click, and Stop; it opens when an agent starts and folds to a tab when they finish.

mods.name: codex-pane
mods.plain: A `/codex` pane that follows the Codex CLI session you run in another terminal, sends the current exchange to Claude on request, or queues Claude's answer in Codex through `codex queue` after confirmation.

mods.name: gsd-status-mod
mods.plain: For GSD projects: shows where work stopped and a STATE.md drift warning above the prompt, adds the handoff's next action to the hint line, and offers the command it names as a Tab suggestion.

mods.name: claude-council
mods.plain: A band above the prompt that brings GPT in as fresh eyes on a stuck question, with its answer, Claude's take and GPT's reply pasted into the chat, and can have Codex check every handover against the chat's spec and send gross violations back before the agent answers.

mods.name: prompt-drafts
mods.plain: End a prompt with `;;` to keep it as a draft of the session instead of sending it, then `/drafts` puts it back in the prompt box from a sidebar with number keys, or from Claude Code's question dialog in a narrow terminal.

mods.name: mission-control
mods.plain: A pane with every subagent and tool call live, plus a code map of the files they read and write, with a Haiku call that describes each file's changes.

mods.name: agent-pager
mods.plain: Pages your phone through ntfy or your own Telegram bot when a long turn ends, a question or permission prompt waits, or a turn errors, and queues your Telegram replies as prompts in the one session you pick with `/pager listen`.

mods.name: session-board
mods.plain: A floating tmux popup with an fzf picker of every Claude Code session running on the machine, showing which ones wait for you, a Haiku summary of each, and a jump to the tmux window of the one you pick.
